items.title: 70399_Theodore _Red_ Saunders oral history interview
items.q: And then I worked with Big Sid Catlett and Louis Armstrong's band.

ctx.x: Were there any other bands beside your own that you recorded with or were with during that time?
Well, let's see, well, I told you the Woody Herman thing. And then I worked with Big Sid Catlett and Louis Armstrong's band.
